documents.title: Bambu PLA Silk Dual Color Technical Data Sheet (Bambu Filament TDS V3.0, headed "PLA Silk")
Bambu PLA Silk Safety Data Sheet SDS20251127A05 (prepared by Shenzhen Tuozhu Technology Co., Ltd.)
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: PLA Silk Multi-Color
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: Scope of the TDS: the store page sells two styles in one product (its own words: "PLA Silk Dual Color" and "PLA Silk Gradient") and links one "Filament TDS", Bambu_PLA_Silk_Dual_Color_Technical_Data_Sheet.pdf, headed "PLA Silk", whose Basic Info describes the Dual-Color style. No separate Gradient TDS is linked. The TDS values are stored at product scope as the product's official TDS; a reviewer may scope them to the dual-colour values instead.

Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values (specimen conditions in test_condition); the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 18 ± 4 MPa, elongation 1.7 ± 0.2 %, bending modulus 1840 ± 160 MPa, bending strength 21 ± 5 MPa, impact 4.6 ± 1.1 kJ/m²) are not stored. Density, melting, glass transition, Vicat and HDT are raw-material properties (ISO 1183, DSC, ISO 306, ISO 75) under material.* / thermal.*, apart from the printed-specimen mechanical.* rows.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 1830 ± 210 MPa, Z 1250 ± 140 MPa), melt index (20.5 ± 1.2 g/10 min at 210 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature (N/A), heat deflection temperature 53 °C at 0.45 MPa, saturated water absorption rate (0.52 % at 25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed with desiccant), bed surface preparation (glue), retraction length (0.6 - 1.0 mm) and speed (20 - 40 mm/s), chamber temperature (25 - 45 °C), max overhang angle (55°), max bridging length (~ 30 mm), support material (Support for PLA), spool material (ABS, temperature resistance 70 °C) and size (diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm), suggested annealing (50 to 55 °C, 6 to 12 hours), odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products rows.
The TDS recommended chamber temperature (25 - 45 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability (number, template field chamber_temp_max), not a filament print setting.

Composition disagreement left for review: TDS "Composition Polylactic acid" vs the manufacturer's SDS (section 3) polylactic acid 60-90 % + thermoplastic polyurethane 10-40 % by wt. material.type keeps the TDS words.

Cautions with no relation kind (only compatible_with / not_compatible_with / requires are written), kept here and not turned into relations: the store FAQ (3.Printing Tips) says "use of this filament with A-series printers is not recommended" for PLA Silk Dual Color (filament rotation risk); the PLA wiki row "PLA Silk / Silk+" says "Not recommended to use low-temperature stabilization board". Because of the A-series caution no "all printers" relation is written, although the material-table wiki gives the generic "PLA*" row Compatible for open-frame and enclosed printers.
The TDS "Bed Surface Preparation Glue" is a recommended setting, not a stated requirement, so no "requires" relation is written.

material.length is not published: the store FAQ (2.Gradient Effects) gives only per-segment figures for the Gradient style ("Each color segment in Bambu PLA Silk Gradient spans approximately 20m (65g+).", "Using 40m (125g+) ...", "80m (250g+) ..."), not the spool's filament length.

The hex table PDF is image-only (one embedded 1190 x 1684 image, an empty text layer), so a text search of the cached document cannot match its quotes; every quote was re-read from the cached render of page 1 and is the printed text in reading order, and each solid block's pixel colour equals its printed code exactly (the gradient swatches start and end near their printed codes). Aurora Purple, South Beach and Dawn Radiance are drawn as gradients without a colour-pair name; the others are drawn as two solid blocks with a pair name such as "(Green-Purple)". The store FAQ calls Dawn Radiance a four-colour gradient ("Bambu PLA Gradient – Dawn Radiance").

Not read: the store page's "Filament RoHS" link (https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0573/5320/7868/files/Bambu_PLA_Silk_RoHS.pdf) is not in the offline cache, so safety.certifications is neither stated nor marked not_published. The builder already records the link as a certificate document.

Adjudication against the second extraction (12 field disagreements), each checked in the cached document: material.type keeps the TDS words "Polylactic acid" (p.3 Composition), not the abbreviation "PLA", as every TDS-sourced material.type keeps the document’s own words. thermal.heat_deflection_temp keeps the 1.8 MPa row (50 °C), the load stored for every filament; the 0.45 MPa row (53 °C), also on TDS p.2, is named in its test_condition. The AMS relation keeps the wiki’s own words "AMS series" (its quote is the PLA wiki row "PLA Silk / Silk+"; "All AMS Series" is the store bullet’s wording, named in its note). The Cool Plate SuperTack locator keeps "Printing Tips (FAQ) › 1.Accessory Compatibility" (the page’s FAQ block titled "Printing Tips"). The hardened steel hotend exclusion stays one row with the phrase the page prints, "Hotend with Hardened Steel Nozzle 0.6 mm / 0.8 mm"; the second extraction’s split labels "… 0.6 mm" and "… 0.8 mm" are not printed and are not added. The four TDS spec-row relations (nozzle sizes 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 mm; Cool Plate, High Temperature Plate, Textured PEI Plate) are stated on TDS p.1 (Nozzle Size, Bed Type) and kept. material.net_weight is written as published (1 kg). The ten hex quotes were re-read on a fresh render of the cached hex table (p.1): each matches the printed text, and each colour, value text and source_value_id matches the store page’s Color option values.
